recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴樣細胞，細胞核有一道明顯的裂隙（cleft）呈腎形／凹陷，染色質中度凝集，周圍有中等量淡藍色細胞質；這是 Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症（淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤）周邊循環的異常淋巴細胞之一，但形態本身不具特異性。
features: Single small-to-medium lymphoid cell slightly larger than a normal lymphocyte
Nucleus with a deep cleft/notch giving a folded contour
Moderately condensed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Background red cells with some overlap; a platelet present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical small-to-medium lymphoid cell with a deeply cleaved nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm. Background red cells are unremarkable in this field, and prominent rouleaux is not evident here. The cell is compatible with a circulating lymphoma cell; in the clinical context of IgM paraproteinemia and MYD88 L265P mutation, findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: FL cells are small with scant cytoplasm and sharp nuclear clefts, CD10+/BCL2+, whereas LPL cells often show plasmacytoid cytoplasm and MYD88 L265P.
MCL cells have irregular nuclei but are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive with t(11;14), which requires ancillary testing.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and a heterogeneous population, not a clonal B-cell population.
SMZL cells may show villous projections and plasmacytoid features; separation from LPL relies on MYD88 status, IgM paraprotein, and marrow pattern.
